opponents._tie_rule_remark: series_add | series_replace | per_subgame. Three teams can each be conformant and each compute a different total for the same level series, so this is declared rather than derived. series_add is the league's common form (this kit, imreeyal, anrbj666 -- who declared it from their own result builder in league issue #47); per_subgame is what the unmodified reference does -- it pays a drawn ROW 2 apiece and applies nothing at series level. With k drawn rows in a level series the two differ by 2(k-1), so they agree only when exactly one row drew. Under Appendix F's permanent values no row can draw at all (a technical loss pays 0/0 and is NOT a draw), so k is 0 and the two rules disagree on every level series -- there is no case a pair could play that would reveal it first.
opponents._counted_remark: counted | counted_sign_off. A pairing is UNCOUNTED unless a human writes both here: `counted: true` plus the sign-off sentence naming where both operators agreed in writing. They feed result_*.json's `league` block -- the machine-readable marker rule 52 hangs on, which imreeyal and best2934 both lacked until league issue #45. No code path writes these two keys, and that is the point: arming the marker is a person editing a file. An armed marker with an empty sign-off disarms itself, because `counted: true` with nothing behind it is the shape a copied fixture makes and it is a false declaration under rules 37-38. Absent means friendly.

network._remark: public_url is this role's path behind the shared front door (tools/frontdoor.py). Both roles are served at once from one reserved ngrok domain, so nothing is repointed between sub-games -- required by the odd/even role convention, where the role flips at every sub-game rather than once at half time.

strategy._exit_min_safe_remark: Refuse a cell with this many ways out or fewer while any alternative exists (rule 47). 2 is the corner count on an unwalled 7x7. Fielded on wire evidence against harness advice: all TWELVE networked thief sub-games we have played -- nine vs gal-roy1, three vs imreeyal -- ended in the same corner (6,6), reached at step 6 and stationary from step 18, identically every time; imreeyal sealed it with two barriers and all three were captures under rule 47. In the local harness this move is worth +47/60 survival against our own fielded cop and -47/60 against a barrier-heavy one -- but that harness cop shares our scent model and transmitted field, and no real opponent has ever captured us by pursuit: imreeyal converted 0 times by chasing and 3 times by walling a corner our own policy walked into. Set to 0 to disable the veto if a real match says otherwise; do not re-pick it from the harness.
strategy._idle_penalty_remark: Leave at 1.0. Our thief stands still for most of a sub-game -- 17 of 22 steps in the reference-v3 dry run -- and a stationary thief saturates its own scent at one cell, which looks like the most useful thing it could possibly hand a pursuer. Panel-tested on 2026-08-14 against five structurally different cops, 30 seeds each, max-min on survival: 1.0 -> worst 0.20 mean 0.67 · 2.0 -> worst 0.00 · 3.0 -> worst 0.00 · 5.0 -> worst 0.00. Every increase is strictly worse and the current value is the best of them. Recorded because the change feels obviously right and is not; the reason appears to be that a thief forced to keep moving walks into walls a stationary one never reaches. Note also that a cop which never walls (barrier_engage_range 0) fails to capture in 30/30 at every level -- pursuit alone cannot close on an equal-speed evader, which is the same fact that moved the cop's own engage range from 1 to 4.
strategy._roam_when_blind_remark: Armed 2026-08-16 after the thief was found frozen on one cell for 30 of 35 steps in every networked sub-game against three separate opponents (anrbj666 30/35, gal-roy1 25/35, imreeyal 30/36), always pinned to an edge. Cause: idle_penalty 1.0 against distance_weight 1.2, so on the far wall STAY beat every move by construction. Under pheromone_transmit_lag 1 a stationary thief publishes its LIVE cell rather than a stale one, and the book trail is exactly invertible -- see domain/trail_inversion.py. Offline the flag takes STAY from 30/35 to 0/35, distinct cells 6 to 18, and steps on an edge 33/36 to 9/36. That is a structural claim, NOT a strength claim: unlike the cop change there is no recovered opponent trajectory to replay a thief against, because cops emit no scent. Set false to revert the whole change.
